messages:
oliver_ae: hey team, oliver here (new AE). quick blockers on day 1: can't find the latest proposal templates in Drive, Outreach SSO returns 'access_denied', and Salesforce contact sync isn't showing my assigned accounts. who owns these?
nina_salesops: welcome oliver! SalesOps here. i shared the proposal pack earlier but maybe permissions didn't apply. confirm email (oliver@redwood.ai) and i'll re-share. for SF sync, did you accept the Okta invite?
onboarding-bot: automated: new-hire checklist created for oliver_ae. items: SalesOps share templates, IT check Outreach SSO, Enablement drop AE 1-pager.
sara_enablement: hey oliver, enablement — AE 1-pager + battlecards here: https://docs.redwood.ai/sales/ae-onboarding (internal). i'll join a quick 15m call to walk through the win themes if you want.
tom_it: filing ticket IT-5801 for Outreach SSO and Salesforce entitlement. logs show last_okta_session: 1750999900. try logging out of Okta and back in; sometimes tokens stale.
oliver_ae: email is oliver@redwood.ai. i did accept Okta but still see access_denied on Outreach. SF shows zero accounts for me.
nina_salesops: re-shared proposal templates and set Drive permission at 1751000100. check your email. i also pushed the ownership mapping to SF: owner_email -> rep_lookup at 1751000125. refresh in 5 mins.
tom_it: Outreach seat assigned and SSO re-provisioned at 1751000180. please try login now.
oliver_ae: Outreach login succeeded, thanks! Drive templates visible. Salesforce now shows my accounts after a refresh — small delay.
sara_enablement: added you to tomorrow's AE roleplay session and dropped the objection handling cheat sheet into the folder. pro tip: use the 'value + validation' opener on first demo.
oliver_ae: perfect. one last Q: where's the approved customer quote library for decks?
nina_salesops: quotes are in the CaseStudies drive under 'approved-quotes' — i added you at 1751000230. if you pull anything into an external deck, ping legal for attribution.
oliver_ae: all set. thanks for the rapid help! :tada:
